scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:unit
scripts.clean: turbo clean && find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -maxdepth 3 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.smoke:chatgpt:report: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d=p.join('apps/browser-extension/test-results/live');if(!fs.existsSync(d)){console.log('No reports yet. Run: pnpm smoke:chatgpt:live');process.exit(0);}const f=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.md')).map(x=>({x,t:fs.statSync(p.join(d,x)).mtime})).sort((a,b)=>b.t-a.t);if(!f.length){console.log('No .md reports found in '+d);process.exit(0);}console.log(fs.readFileSync(p.join(d,f[0].x),'utf8'));"
